headline:
September 18.
Miss it, and you wait
[[a full year]] to refile.
attribution: Roger Averbuj, Broker | Prestige Heritage Realty | (954) 663-8461
deck: Broward's absolute deadline to file a 2026 exemption, homestead, senior, disability, or veteran, is September 18. State law allows no exceptions after that date.
takeaway: File once. It renews itself every year after.
